summary: Tested new Career Paths feature end-to-end: 11 pytest backend tests (auth guards, cached analysis, guidance GET/PUT/plan/ask endpoints, learning resources, jobs-for-path) all pass; frontend UI verified via Playwright with seeded session cookie — nav item, current-path banner, 5 recommended path cards, expanded PathGuidance panel, skill checkbox toggle persistence (PUT /paths/guidance/skills), Learning Resources modal (course cards render for Tableau/Python/etc.), Jobs modal (graceful empty state, no 500), Regenerate button present, Start over confirm flow present. Dashboard regression OK.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Talk to Coach' button (data-testid=open-coach-btn) and choice-screen 'entry-coach-btn' navigate to /coach, but no <Route path='/coach'> is defined in App.js — clicking these will land on a 404/blank. Either add the route or remove/disable the buttons.
Typo className 'bg-muted0 hover:bg-foreground' — 'bg-muted0' is not a valid Tailwind class (looks like intended 'bg-foreground' or 'bg-muted'). Button renders but with unstyled background.

issues: Current-path banner uses class 'bg-foreground   text-white' (extra spaces harmless). 'text-background' inside dark banner reads correctly but 'text-sidebar-muted' small labels are readable — OK.

action_items: Add missing /coach route in App.js OR remove the Talk-to-Coach / entry-coach-btn buttons that navigate('/coach').
Fix invalid Tailwind class 'bg-muted0' in CareerPaths.jsx (line ~258) and PathGuidance.jsx (line ~271).
critical_code_review_comments: CareerPaths.jsx is 741 lines — consider splitting Learning Resources modal and Jobs modal into their own components (file-size guideline >700 lines).

Auth-guard on POST/PUT endpoints returns 422 (Pydantic body validation) BEFORE auth check when body is missing. Minor: consider validating auth first so unauthenticated requests always get 401. Not blocking.

openLearningResources / openJobs use raw fetch(..., {credentials:'include'}) while other calls use apiFetch — works because cookie is set, but inconsistent and would fail if the app moved to header-only auth. Prefer apiFetch throughout.
One benign 404 in browser console during page load (asset). Investigate if it's a real missing resource.
